Name: Love Bubbles
Author: SteelixLeiter
Description:
[b][color=#6aa84f]Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI 1.14+[/url].
Compatible with (and intended for use in conjunction with) [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/859/?]Better Ranching[/url].
[/color][/b][color=#6aa84f]
[color=#ffffff]Inspired by the excellent [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/859/?]Better Ranching[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/279/?]Loved Labels[/url] mods, this mod shows a heart speech bubble above any animal you haven't pet today (optionally including dogs and cats). I wrote this mod for my own use because I use Better Ranching and wanted a petting indicator that was aesthetically consistent with that mod as well as being visible by default.

In the case of animals with milk or wool available to harvest, if Better Ranching is installed, this mod will defer to Better Ranching by hiding the petting indicator while the ranching indicator is present.
